how.title: How Captain Training Works
how.p1Html: Each Training Credit you spend starts one training pull. The outcome is chosen at random on our servers using the odds listed for your galaxy and its current round. Every pull gives exactly one outcome: some Experience, or a Captain.
how.p2Html: Training Credits can be earned in play and can also be bought with real money in the in-game shop. The odds are the same however you got your credits.
how.p3: Experience goes into your available Experience pool, and you choose which captain receives it.
notes.title: Additional Notes
notes.server: Odds are determined server-side at the moment of each pull. No client-side manipulation is possible.
notes.independent: The probability of each outcome is independent. Previous pulls do not affect future results.
notes.rounds: Odds are set for each galaxy's round. When a galaxy moves to a new round, its odds may change, and this page is updated automatically.
